Why Clients Choose VoiceoverGuy

Finding the right voice shouldn’t feel like a gamble. Most clients arrive here after dealing with late deliveries, messy audio, or someone who disappears the moment the script changes. I built my career on the opposite: fast turnaround, clear communication, and broadcast-quality audio every single time.

After 25 years and more than 200,000 voiceovers – from studio sessions to Attenborough style narration – one thing has stayed the same: your job gets a lot easier when your voice artist actually shows up, takes direction, and delivers exactly what you need.

🚧 The Problem Most People Arrive With

Voiceovers should make your project better, not more stressful. But many clients land here after dealing with unreliable voices, missed deadlines, or audio recorded in what sounds suspiciously like a cupboard.

You need someone who can hit the read, follow direction, and deliver quickly – whether it’s for a gameshow-style delivery or a simple corporate read – all without the drama.

<

⚡ A Voice You Don’t Have to Chase

I’m in the studio every day – this isn’t a hobby or a side gig. If you need a same-day turnaround, a script change, or an extra take, I’m ready. Everything is recorded in a fully treated professional booth using broadcast-grade equipment.

My job is simple: make your job easier – whether it’s a clean explainer, a solid narrative read, or a punchier trailer-style voiceover.

🎙️ 25 Years, 200,000+ Voiceovers

Over the last quarter of a century, I’ve voiced just about everything – radio ads, TV promos, games, characters, eLearning, explainers, in-store messaging, on-hold, the lot.

That includes cartoon characters, pirate voices, sports commentator reads, and even authentic Pathé News style narration.

Some clients have been with me for over 20 years because they know they’ll always get consistent quality, reliability, and a read that works.

👌 Easy to Work With

No fuss. No ego. No disappearing act. If a wrong script is sent, we fix it. If you want alternatives, I’ll record them. Need a character voice like Santa, a spooky Halloween read, or my David Attenborough impression? I switch instantly.

Working with me should feel like ticking a box on your to-do list – not adding another one.

💼 Premium… But Worth It

Yes, you’ll find cheaper voices on Fiverr – but you won’t get the same consistency, speed, experience, or broadcast level audio. What you’re paying for isn’t just the voice.

You’re paying for peace of mind that your project – whether it’s a Voice of God announcement or a national radio campaign – will be delivered properly, on time, every time.

🌍 Trusted by Big Brands

I’ve voiced for Apple, Disney, ITV, BBC, Lego, and thousands of smaller businesses who needed a professional sound. Whether it’s a studio-recorded read or a full character performance, I bring the same care, quality, and attention.

Big brands, small brands, agencies – they come back because they know exactly what they’re getting.

If you need a voice that’s fast, reliable, easy to direct, and delivers broadcast-quality audio every single time… you’ve found the right Guy.

Why not hear my Attenborough style or my Santa voice to get a feel for what I can do?
